name: Micree
summary:
Micree is an innovative VR app that allows users to acquire practical professional skills through immersive training scenarios. Each user can follow an individual development path tailored to their interests and needs. After putting on VR goggles, you enter a virtual lobby - a center from which you can move to various educational spaces and learn through action.
